children: The final trading day of the week will see one-third of the number of results that were reported on Thursday, but that does not take away from the fact that there are many important numbers that will be reported during the course of the day. Hindalco is among the Nifty 50 constituents reporting numbers today, along with broader market names such as Aster DM, Azad Engineering, Blue Dart, Bosch, Carraro India, Cohance Life, Data Patterns, Gland Pharma, Godrej Agrovet, Honasa Consumer, Jubilant Foodworks, Landmark Cars, Rain Industries, TTK Prestige, Voltas, and West Coast Paper among many others. There are tonnes of companies that reported numbers for the September quarter after market hours on Thursday. Prominent among them include ONGC, Titan, Bharti Airtel, Bharti Hexacom, HCC, LIC, Sonata Software, Thermax, Fortis Healthcare, VST Industries, Astral, Antony Waste, among many others.
Watch this space for all the Live Q2 results updates, management commentary, brokerage views and a lot more.

title: Q2 Results Live Updates: Hindalco, Voltas, Aster report today; Bharti Airtel, Britannia, LIC react
